list.definition: SELECT meter_id::text FROM meters ORDER BY meter_id

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', r.event_time, 'Africa/Kigali') AS time, m.region AS metric,
       sum(r.energy_kwh) AS energy_kwh, count(*) AS reading_count
FROM energy_readings r JOIN meters m ON m.meter_id = r.meter_id
WHERE r.event_time >= time_bucket('1 day', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, 'Africa/Kigali') AND r.event_time < (time_bucket('1 day', $__timeTo()::timestamptz - INTERVAL '1 microsecond', 'Africa/Kigali') + INTERVAL '1 day')
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT time_bucket('1 day', r.event_time, 'Africa/Kigali') AS time,
       sum(r.energy_kwh) AS energy_kwh, count(*) AS reading_count
FROM energy_readings r
WHERE r.event_time >= time_bucket('1 day', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, 'Africa/Kigali') AND r.event_time < (time_bucket('1 day', $__timeTo()::timestamptz - INTERVAL '1 microsecond', 'Africa/Kigali') + INTERVAL '1 day')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Network energy per seven-day period from 1 Sep (kWh)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(time_bucket('7 days', r.event_time, TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-01 00:00+02'), 'DD Mon') AS period,
       sum(r.energy_kwh) AS energy_kwh, count(*) AS reading_count
FROM energy_readings r
WHERE r.event_time >= time_bucket('1 day', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, 'Africa/Kigali') AND r.event_time < (time_bucket('1 day', $__timeTo()::timestamptz - INTERVAL '1 microsecond', 'Africa/Kigali') + INTERVAL '1 day')
GROUP BY time_bucket('7 days', r.event_time, TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-01 00:00+02')
ORDER BY time_bucket('7 days', r.event_time, TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-01 00:00+02')

SELECT time_bucket('1 day', r.event_time, 'Africa/Kigali') AS time,
       sum(r.energy_kwh) AS energy_kwh, count(*) AS reading_count
FROM energy_readings r
WHERE r.meter_id = $meter AND r.event_time >= time_bucket('1 day', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, 'Africa/Kigali') AND r.event_time < (time_bucket('1 day', $__timeTo()::timestamptz - INTERVAL '1 microsecond', 'Africa/Kigali') + INTERVAL '1 day')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH registered AS (SELECT region, count(*) AS meters FROM meters GROUP BY region),
     observed AS (
        SELECT m.region, count(*) AS reading_count
        FROM energy_readings r JOIN meters m ON m.meter_id = r.meter_id
        WHERE r.event_time >= time_bucket('1 day', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, 'Africa/Kigali') AND r.event_time < (time_bucket('1 day', $__timeTo()::timestamptz - INTERVAL '1 microsecond', 'Africa/Kigali') + INTERVAL '1 day')
        GROUP BY m.region)
SELECT g.region, coalesce(o.reading_count, 0) AS reading_count,
       g.meters * 96 * (extract(epoch FROM (time_bucket('1 day', $__timeTo()::timestamptz - INTERVAL '1 microsecond', 'Africa/Kigali') + INTERVAL '1 day') - time_bucket('1 day', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, 'Africa/Kigali')) / 86400) AS planned_readings,
       100.0 * coalesce(o.reading_count, 0) / (g.meters * 96 * (extract(epoch FROM (time_bucket('1 day', $__timeTo()::timestamptz - INTERVAL '1 microsecond', 'Africa/Kigali') + INTERVAL '1 day') - time_bucket('1 day', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, 'Africa/Kigali')) / 86400)) AS completeness_pct
FROM registered g LEFT JOIN observed o USING (region)
ORDER BY substring(region FROM 8)::int
